items.Description: This ghastly magical staff is the legbone of the evil Khonderous Vilemoth, a wickedly evil Pale Master who lost this limb and his life to a brave but nameless paladin. Vilemoth's pupils took the limb, polished it and enchanted it with the magic of their master.

items.Name: Stained Letter
items.Description: This letter instructs some mercenaries to join up with Sir Leonard Wildbrand. It has his own signature.

items.Name: Stolen Picture
items.Description: This is the picture you stole from the Crestian wizard's tower.

items.Name: Sudnar's Adamantine Helm
items.Description: This unique adamantine helm is probably some kind of loot.

items.Name: Suzail's Pearl
items.Description: This wine was brewed in the far city of Suzail. Not the best, but some people like it for its almond taste.

items.Name: The Art of War
items.Description: This book is written in an unknown language. It seems oriental to you.

items.Name: The Protector Gem
items.Description: The owner of this gem will be ignored by a family-bound greater elemental.

items.Name: Top
items.Description: This is a child's toy top.

items.Name: Unknown Crystal
items.Description: Looks like a crude key.

items.Name: Viltor's Key
items.Description: This key opens the Musical Instrument Maker's cellar.

items.Name: Vriur's Leather Hauberk
items.Description: Another fine piece of craftsmanship from an unknown maker.

items.Name: Poison Arrow
items.Description: A sticky yellow substance coats the head of the missile. It is said missiles such as these sap the strength from the muscles of those struck by it.

items.Name: Wand of Arcane Disjunction
items.Description: Of all the items sold to adventurers and militias, Wands of Arcane Disjunction cause the most dissent and argument among wizards and sorcerers. items.Description: This is some kind of key.

items.Name: Water Canteen
items.Description:
This is a water canteen. No adventurer should be without one.

Target a source of water to fill the canteen, or target the ground near you while you are standing next to water.

items.Description: This whistle is for calling the pony.

items.Name: Yanor's Head

items.Name: Yet Another Key
items.Description: This key is quite heavy.

items.Name: Zacho's Chest Key
items.Description: This key is supposed to open Zacho's chest.
